thesis: A government-IT incumbent with ROIC up from 9.9% to 14.2% and a 13.80% FCF yield funding buybacks trades below its own 5-year minimum on every earnings multiple and below peers, where the price implies a -13.7% revenue decline that its contract base does not show.
reason: Rising quality, a strong FCF yield and a price below even the mechanical bear value give a favourable skew. The unexplained mid-year crash, single-customer budget risk, re-levering for M&A, a bearish rate backdrop and results on Nov 3 hold conviction at 4, not 5: standard volatility-scaled core size.

triggers.text: TTM operating margin falls below 10%, reversing the five-year expansion from 8.5% to 11.8%.
TTM ROIC falls below 10%, erasing the improvement from 9.9% in FY2021 to 14.2%.
TTM FCF margin falls below 6%, under the FY2022 five-year low of 6.0%, showing the cash step-up was transitory.
Net debt/EBITDA on the ratios page rises above 3.0x (2.45x TTM now) without a visible deleveraging path from the Entrust/Analogic debt.
